items.title: Ernest Roubleau Interview, 1961-10-18
items.q: But I had to teach it on the banjo from, uh... This man, Dave Perkins, who died.

ctx.x: Then you took up the guitar later.

That's right. Did you have any teachers on those other instruments? I had to teach on the banjo, but not on guitar. Who helped? My father helped me with the violin. Yes. But I had to teach it on the banjo from, uh... This man, Dave Perkins, who died.
Dave Perkins. I've heard of him. I never knew him.
